tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The logo's navy. The upper half-disc of the mark, the wordmark, the clinician app bar and the dark app icon. Same value in every theme.

tokens.name: brand-mint
tokens.usage: The logo's mint. The lower half-disc of the mark and small brand accents (the active-nav underline, the recording progress bar, selected-row bars). Never text on light surfaces: 1.8:1 on white. Text and marks on brand-navy: 9.6:1.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Mint darkened until it can carry text: 6.2:1 on white. The light theme's links, focus ring and accent text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The theme's base: white in light, the brand navy in dark, where it is also the page's ground (surface-page). Pages stand on surface-page, not on surface; the text tokens' ratios are given on it.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The ground under every page's surfaces: what is on it (cards, tables, toolbars, the sign-in card) sits on surface-raised, so each has an edge. Text on it keeps the ratios it has on surface-subtle in light and surface in dark.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: side panels, table headers, read-only fields, a table row under the pointer. In light, also the page's ground (surface-page).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, toolbars, menus and dialogs sitting on the page's ground (surface-page) or on surface-subtle. In light it relies on a line border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, table rules, panel borders. Decorative only, never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on surface, surface-subtle and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface, surface-subtle, surface-raised and every *-soft fill: 15:1 or more in light, 10.5:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, hints, timestamps, table captions. On surface, surface-subtle and surface-raised: 6.2:1 or more in light, 6.9:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button per view (Sign note…, Sign note, Dictate, Open the chart).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary: white on navy in light (17:1), navy on mint in dark (9.6:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Decorative brand marks inside the UI: the active-nav underline, the selected-row bar, progress. Pair it with text or shape; never text on light.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Links and accent text on surface, surface-subtle and accent-soft: 5.5:1 or more in light, 6.8:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the current item in a list, reviewed dictation fields. Text on it is ink or accent-ink.

tokens.name: appbar
tokens.usage: Background of the clinician, off-site and admin app bar. It stays dark in both themes, so the reversed lockup always sits on it.

tokens.name: on-appbar
tokens.usage: Nav links and the signed-in name on appbar: 17:1 in light, 16:1 in dark.

tokens.name: appbar-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on appbar, such as the role and the site label: 7.7:1 or more.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, allergies, failed saves, the offline dot, the recording dot and emergency access. Text on surface and danger-soft: 5.5:1 or more in light, 6:1 or more in dark. Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger notices and the allergy chip. Text on it is ink or danger.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Read-only and caution states: the off-site read-only notice, dictation fields awaiting review, restricted records. Text on surface and warning-soft: 5.7:1 or more in light, 8:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning notices, such as the read-only band and dictation consent. Text on it is ink or warning.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, signed, synced, online. Text on surface and success-soft: 4.7:1 or more in light, 7.3:1 or more in dark. Hard to tell from danger by color alone, so always paired with a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success notices. Text on it is ink or success.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral system news, such as a sync finishing or a new version, and proposed fields still being sorted. Text on surface and info-soft: 5.9:1 or more in light, 6.7:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info notices. Text on it is ink or info.

tokens.name: status-unknown
tokens.usage: The connection dot while the state is still being checked: 4.2:1 or more on surface and surface-subtle in light, 6:1 or more in dark. Shown beside the word "Checking".

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 5.7:1 or more on every light surface, 8:1 or more on every dark one.

tokens.name: highlight-unclear
tokens.usage: Marks a word the speech model was unsure of in a transcript. Ink on it: 12:1 in light, 7.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: highlight-source
tokens.usage: Marks the transcript words a proposed dictation field came from, while that field has focus. Ink on it: 12:1 in light, 8.7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: row-flagged
tokens.usage: Audit-log rows that need review, such as emergency access. Ink and ink-muted stay above 5.7:1 on it in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Portal and sign-in hero lines, slide titles. At most once per screen.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Panel headings and the patient's name in the patient banner.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You can look at records, but nothing can be saved until the clinic's server is back.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The state that opens a notice, a short sentence of its own; emphasis inside body.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Ordered 2 days ago by Dr. Chen
styles.usage: Dense clinician tables, metadata and hints.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, table headers, button text.

styles.name: portal-body
styles.sample: Your test result is ready. It is in the normal range.
styles.usage: Body text in the patient portal and in patient email.

styles.name: mono-id
styles.usage: Audit row IDs and other IDs compared character by character. Dates, times and MRNs are the text font with tabular figures.

styles.name: mono-shortcut
styles.usage: Keyboard shortcuts on buttons and in hints.

styles.name: mono-code
styles.usage: Codes people read aloud or type: authenticator keys, enrollment codes, recovery codes.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Clinician screens use the small steps (dense); the portal uses the large ones.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon or dot and its word; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell padding, vertical.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, horizontal; gap between a label and its input group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and notice padding in clinician apps; gutter between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: App bar side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; portal card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Portal section spacing; space above a page title.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Sign-in and portal hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Text highlights in transcripts; keyboard-shortcut chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags, table containers: everything in the clinician apps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, notices, the patient banner, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, and cards in the patient portal.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and the recording dot only.

tokens.name: radius-app-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon's corner, as a share of its side. Only for the app icon artwork.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows, separate things on the page. Shadows only lift layers that float above it.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, autocomplete lists and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, such as confirming a signature or giving an emergency-access reason.

tokens.name: appbar-height
tokens.usage: Height of every app bar.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs in the clinician, off-site, admin and desktop apps.

tokens.name: control-height-portal
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs in the patient portal: comfortable touch targets.

tokens.name: width-form
tokens.usage: Sign-in, registration and account forms: one narrow column.

tokens.name: width-reading
tokens.usage: Long reading: portal results, signed notes, email bodies.

tokens.name: width-content
tokens.usage: Clinician pages, such as the chart with its side panels.
